reviews.x: I thought this was a fantastic idea. I tend to run around in flip flops during the summer, so I was looking for an effective way to get my feet really clean at the end of the day (and the pouf I use in the shower was not cutting it!). Well, I was a little disappointed in that the suction cups don't stick to my shower floor (we have a stand alone shower w/ textured floor), and the pumice stone cracked in half during the first use. I will say that after a couple weeks of use (and getting the hang

I received and Easy Feet (from Walmart) for my birthday last month.  As others have said, mine does not adhere to my shower floor.  I also broke the pumice stone during the first use because I accidentally stepped on it with all my weight.  Having said that, I really do enjoy my EF. It feels tingly and good.  My feet feel pampered, and my heels less cracked from using the pumice stone.  I think it feels good and I would purchase one for a fried/family member.

I bought this for my elderly mom and she loves it.  It is hard for her to bend over to wash her feet and this is perfect for her.  I bought one for myself and I too like it, but it is not for the sensitive feet, as it can be a little ticklish.

reviews.t: Best solution for daily foot cleaning
reviews.x: This product works great for me, and is in fact my 2nd Easy Feet, as near daily usage for 2 years finally wore out the first one.  My shower stall has a tile floor and the suction cups stick really well. I wear sandals everyday, and like to feel my feet are clean before bed.  I know the product works because I used to have to scrub the dirt from my shower stall floor every week, but since using Easy Feet, my shower floor always looks clean.  I would caution users to make sure you're holding onto

reviews.t: Ideal for Overweight and/or elderly and/or diabetics
reviews.x: I am all of those: Being overweight, foot care is a real chore. And as a diabetic, it is also critical. This does a fantastic job. As a matter-of-fact, even if I were younger and lighter weight, this would still be a superior way to clean feet. I should note that I attempted to buy this from Amazon but, at the time it, was sold-out, so I went to Target and found it there. But it has proven to be such a great product, I thought I would still like to leave positive feedback.

reviews.t: I would give it a NO star, if I could
reviews.x: This product will stick to nothing this product is useless.  Won't stick in  my shower, won't stick in my bathtub, won't stick on the patio, and every other place my DH and I got creative enough to try.  Do not waste your money, and I bought mine from the easy feet people, dumb, because I paid an arm and a leg for postage.  I am going to try to get my money back and return them but I am not going to hold my breath.  Will let you know what happens.  There is a sucker born every minute and today,
The pumice stone is supposed to stay on but will not because there is only two tiny drops of glue on the back of it.  I wasn't able to use it because the pumice stone wouldn't stay attached.

I thought this would be great for my feet.  I have trouble getting down to scrub my feet soles.  The item came.  I unboxed it and the next morning I took my shower.  The suction cups do stick to the shower floor, but it slides around when I tried to scrub my sole.  I ended up having to stick it in a corner to use and use my other foot to keep it from coming out of the corner.  It does clean well, but the instability is a real problem.  Plus the first time I stepped down on it to activate the suc

I thought this product was the answer to a problem....but it wasn't.  TBH, its a great idea....but there are a couple flaws that need to be addressed. First, the claim that it will stick to all tub or shower surfaces is a fallacy that most people who own fiberglass tubs and showers should know. If you have a slippery tile or enamel floor to your bathtub or shower you will be good to go. But who wants to have a slippery shower floor?  The second flaw is the curved piece that sits over the base.

This is the 3rd time we have purchased this item and would order again.  It is hard for my husband to bend and wash his feet after extensive back surgery and this has made his like so much easier. This is not to be stood on using your body weight as the pumas stone will break.  So if you just use it to clean your feet and not for something to stand on it will do exactly what it was made to do and do it well.
I bought this for my Dad for Father's Day this year. He has a hard time bending over to wash his feet in the shower and had mentioned that he wanted to try this product. He absolutely loves it!
I bought this for my boyfriend who works on his feet all day and has gross feet to prove it. He LOVES it, it works great. I use it too and it's really nice.
wife & I are enjoying it, only thing that I didnt like was the pumice stone cracked in half the first day used
some of the suction cups snapped off the first week I used it. I wasn't very happy with it overall.
really helpful in the shower! too many of us forget to clean our feet! this makes it easy peasy :)

I want to like this, I really do, but it's just not possible. It refuses to solidly stick to the floor of my shower, no matter how many times I clean it. It's not really making the foot washing thing any easier. By the time you've finished soaping it up, carefully swishing your feet on it, washing the soap off the bristles and finding somewhere to put this big (and it IS big), dripping piece of plastic you could have taken a facecloth to your feet 3 times.

Do not buy this product. It is cheaply made and started to fall apart right away. The suction cups do not hold, so once the shower gets wet, it slides around. One of the suction cups fell off and also some of the bristles.  The pumice stone is too small and it came unglued from the plastic. My husband secured it with a plastic "tight-on" and it stays put, but it is still too small to do any real good.  It was a waste of money!

I have some hip problems, and this product allows me to get my feet clean in the shower, and the stone on the heel area of the scrubber is nice to use, as well.  It is a pretty solid item and does not feel like a cheap flimsy product.  I hate not being able to not thoroughly clean my feet, and this product has remedied that issue.  Glad I pulled the trigger on this!

The thing works. It does exactly what it's advertised to do at a price that makes it available for almost anyone. I have diabetes and it's important for me to take special care of my feet. This scrubber makes it easy for me to wash and stimulate the top, bottom and sides of my feet. It's stable. It doesn't move around after the suction cups are properly engaged.

The apparatus is a good concept, but I havnt been able to secure it to the shower floor. I have to use it jamed agains the wall or corner of shower stall.  This prevents getting the right angle for your foot and makes the pumice stone basically useless.  However... If you can get it to secured to the shower floor so it doesnt move around, it would be wonderful

This was probably a stupid purchase on my part but it looked really cool and I had seen it at cvs so I just ordered it. The foot cleaner is not as nice as in the picture but the functionality is horrible. It slips and doesn't really do much to my foot. I gave it three stars because it was priced very well but not too effective in cleaning feet.

I almost wish I had more than 2 feet! Scrubs tops and bottoms of feet all at once. Pumice stone is nice. Easy Feet sticks where I need it and comes up when I am finished with it - just slide it a bit sideways first. There seems to be a lot of room for different sized feet (mine are very small.  No, my parents did not bind them.)

I'm very disappointed with the product!!! The first one I owned was great, it was built sturdy and lasted a couple of years. This one is cheap, cheap, cheap. I bought some super glue to try gluing the bottom suction cups. They keep coming out and scratching my tub.

Easy Feet is absolute wonderful and I would definitely recommend it . You are able to thoroughly wash your feet easily and it also feels like you are giving your foot a massage. It is very nice. I highly recommend it to everyone.

reviews.t: Okay product but not what I was expecting
reviews.x: I was expecting a lot more bristles and a better quality pumice stone. The suction cups work but it's very hard to pull off the surface and the. The pumice stone broke when I tried pulling it off the shower wall to use it.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it genuinely helpful for people who have trouble bending over to wash their feet, such as elderly or post-surgery users.
A common complaint is that the suction cups fail to adhere to shower or tub surfaces, or that the unit slides around during use.
Several reviewers report the pumice stone breaking or detaching, sometimes on the first use.
Some users describe the product as a great idea that works well for daily foot cleaning and would buy it again.
A few reviewers note the scrubbing sensation can be ticklish or too much for sensitive feet.
